try: Open Sophia's lead
how:
1. On Leads, click Sophia Wong's name
2. Read the header
3. Press the back arrow, look at her row, then open her again
expect: Her "Overview" opens with chips 9765 4321 · S$ 60K · HDB 4-ROOM · REFERRAL and "Stage: New"; her row's band is gone.
in10: Different from 1.0: a full page with tabs, not a drawer

try: Check her details on the left
how:
1. On her Overview, read the left column
2. Look at "Lead info", "Property info" and "Other info"
expect: Lead info: Stage New, Source Referral, Budget (S$) 60,000; Property info: HDB 4-Room, District East, Resale, in 3 months, her address.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Try to move her before anyone owns her
how:
1. Click "Stage: New" and point at "Contacted"
2. Close the menu
3. Point at, then press, "Convert to Project"
expect: Contacted is greyed with "Assign a member first"; Convert to Project wears a lock and answers "Assign a member first".
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Assign the member the studio suggests
how:
1. In the left column, under "Collaborators", click "Assign Member"
2. Read the "Suggested · …" box
3. Press "Assign to Sarah"
expect: "Suggested · Sarah" explains why (HDB 4-Room, East area); one press assigns her: "Members updated" and Sarah shows under Collaborators.
in10: Different from 1.0: a line in Assign, scored the same way

try: Set a reminder to follow up tomorrow
how:
1. In the "LEAD STAGES" card click "Next follow-up" (None set)
2. In "Set a follow-up", pick tomorrow at 10:00 AM for "When"
3. Keep the "Task" name, press "Save"
expect: "Follow-up set for …" appears; Next follow-up now reads "Follow up with Sophia Wong" with tomorrow's day, date and "10:00 AM"; open the task and its Due keeps the time — change only the day and 10:00 AM stays.
in10: Different from 1.0: the follow-up is a task, not a lead date

try: Add her NRIC and correct her key collection
how:
1. Open ⋮ ("More options"), then "Edit"
2. "NRIC / FIN": S8812345D · "Key collection": Collected
3. Press "Save"
4. In Lead info, press "Show" beside NRIC / FIN
expect: "Details saved"; Lead info shows NRIC / FIN masked as •••••345D, and "Show" (Owners and Admins only) reveals S8812345D; Property info shows Key collection Collected.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Check the call log asks for what it needs
how:
1. Click "Stage: New", then "Contacted"
2. In the "Move stage" window press "Save" without filling anything
expect: "Moving to Contacted"; red messages under the empty fields and "Unable to move. Please fill in the required fields."; channels include "In person".
in10: Different from 1.0: a screenshot is needed to log contact

try: Log the call and pick the suggested tasks
how:
1. "Contacted via" Call · "Date & Time" today, now · "Outcome" Callback requested
2. Under "Schedule a call/meeting (optional)": two days from now, 11:00 AM · "Preferred mode" Call
3. Under "Attach screenshots of your call attempts" press "Attach", tick sophia-floor-plan.pdf (any file will do), press "Attach 1 File", then "Save"
4. In "Suggested tasks" tick the suggestion, press "Save"
expect: "Auto added" shows "Follow up with the client via Call on …"; then "Moved to Contacted" and the button reads "Stage: Contacted".
in10: Different from 1.0: a scheduled call becomes a task automatically

try: Find the call in Notes & Logs
how:
1. Open the "Notes & Logs" tab
2. Click the Call contact log in the list
expect: The log shows Call · Callback requested; its header reads "Added during stage movement — view only".
in10: New in 2.0

try: Write a quick note that saves itself
how:
1. In "Notes & Logs" click "New", then "Note"
2. Title: Site visit prep; write a line about her kitchen
3. Click another item in the list
expect: The note stays in the list under its title — there is no Save button to press.
in10: Different from 1.0: many dated notes, not one field

try: Log a WhatsApp chat with Auto Fill
how:
1. Click "New", then "Contact Log"
2. Press "Auto Fill", then "Upload", and pick sophia-whatsapp-chat.txt
3. Read the line at the top of the log, then in "Add tasks" press "Save"
4. Press "Save" under the log (if "Add tasks" opens again, press "Cancel")
5. Try "Auto Fill" once more with any photo
expect: The log fills from the chat's own words: WhatsApp, 8/10/2026 7:16 PM, Meeting scheduled, and the meeting on 10/10/2026 3:00 PM in person; the line says what filled, and the chat file is attached. "1 task added", then "Contact log saved". A photo is attached and fills nothing — the line says "We can't read pictures yet — type what was said".
in10: Different from 1.0: the file's words are read by rule (a chat export, an email or call notes) — no AI, no credits; a screenshot isn't read

try: Tick off the follow-up you just did
how:
1. Open the "Tasks" tab
2. Find "Follow up with Sophia Wong"
3. Click its round check ("Mark as completed")
expect: The list holds your follow-ups with due dates and the suggestion; the ticked one now shows a filled check.
in10: New in 2.0

try: Add a task and give it a due date
how:
1. Click "Add Task", then "Create New Task"
2. Type Send Sophia the HDB renovation checklist, press Enter
3. In its "Due date" cell click the calendar ("Set due date") and pick Friday, then "Done"
expect: The new task sits at the top of the list, glowing once, with its due date reading "Fri, … · 10:00 AM".
in10: New in 2.0

try: Find her floor plan and make a folder
how:
1. Open the "Files" tab
2. Check sophia-floor-plan.pdf is there
3. Click the "New Folder" icon, name it Site photos, press "Save"
expect: The floor plan attached when she was created is listed; "Folder created" and a Site photos folder appears.
in10: Different from 1.0: folders, trash and comments

try: Upload a photo into the folder
how:
1. Click the Site photos folder to open it
2. Click "New File", then "From Local Files"
3. Pick sophia-living-room.jpg
expect: "Uploading 1 file", then "File uploaded"; a tile named sophia-living-room.jpg appears, showing her living-room photo.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Leave your team a comment on the photo
how:
1. Double-click the photo to open it
2. Click the "Comments" icon (top right)
3. Type Check the window measurements, press Enter
4. Press the back arrow ("Back to Files")
expect: Your comment appears under your name; the panel notes "Clients can’t see these comments".
in10: New in 2.0

try: Answer one of the studio's questions
how:
1. Open the "Questionnaire" tab
2. On the first question press "Answer"
3. Type a short answer, press "Save"
expect: Her lead already holds the studio's questions (Company › Questionnaire, chapter 3's included); "Answer saved" and your answer shows after "A:".
in10: Different from 1.0: the studio answers here; clients use the portal

try: Ask Sophia to answer the rest herself
how:
1. Press "Ask Client"
2. In "Ask the client", read the ticked "Questions to ask", then press "Copy" beside "Portal link"
3. Press "Send via WhatsApp" — a WhatsApp tab opens: close it, do not send
expect: The box says it also invites Sophia to your portal; then "Asked Sophia Wong — … questions are on their page"; the summary now reads "Client asked on" with today's date.
in10: Same as 1.0 (a WhatsApp with her link; one ask per 5 minutes)

try: Record the showroom meeting
how:
1. Click "Stage: Contacted", then "Met"
2. "Where": Showroom · "Date & Time": today, now
3. Press "Save"
expect: "Moved to Met"; the header button reads "Stage: Met".
in10: Different from 1.0: a meeting log with where and when

try: Look back at the call — stages never move back
how:
1. In the "LEAD STAGES" card, click the "Contacted" row
2. Read the window, then press "Cancel"
expect: "Contacted details" opens read-only, with "Edit" on the log and "Add Log" at the top; there is no Save button.
in10: Different from 1.0: done stages open read-only; nothing moves back

try: Read her journey at a glance
how:
1. On "Overview", read the "LEAD STAGES" card
2. Read the three lines under the stages
expect: New, Contacted ticked, Met current; Next follow-up shows your earliest dated task; Response time reads like "Assigned in … · First contact in …".
in10: Different from 1.0: one line instead of a Response time card

try: Read everything that happened to her lead
how:
1. Open the "Activity" tab
2. Scroll through today
expect: Among the lines: "You added Sarah to the lead.", "You changed the lead’s details — …" and "You asked Sophia Wong to answer … questions."
in10: Different from 1.0: built from records, plus logged edits and asks

try: See Sophia's progress from the list
how:
1. Go back to "Leads"
2. Find Sophia Wong's row
expect: Stage Met, Sarah under Members, a task in Tasks, and the District, Next follow-up and Last contact columns filled in.
in10: Same as 1.0
